svg.title: Whitesnake → C-MOON → Made in Heaven
svg.desc: Steals memories and Stands, and keeps them as discs. Gravity turns upside down around Pucci: whatever it hits turns inside out. Accelerates time until the universe starts over. Heaven is here.
